title: B.Sc / M.Sc Physics | KSS KPGU
content: n Across Fundamental and Applied Domains 01 B.Sc. in Physics is offered as a 4-year undergraduate program under NEP (8 semesters), focusing on conceptual understanding, analytical reasoning, and practical skills in physics. 02 Physics examines matter, energy, space, and time from elementary particles to the universe. The core objective is to understand how physical systems and processes work through scientific principles and evidence.
